title: News enters the price gradually
hook: Two stated cases: explore the remaining adjustment after a news signal.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the remaining adjustment after a news signal affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Estimate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the remaining adjustment after a news signal in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
